methods.steps: Run ffmpeg -i camera.mov -an -c:v libx265 encoded.hevc.
methods.limits: Requires libx265; makes a new lossy encode.

methods.steps: For HEVC source video run ffmpeg -i camera.mov -an -c:v copy extracted.hevc.
methods.limits: Source must already use HEVC.

methods.steps: Run ffmpeg -i edit.mov -f mp4 -c:a aac -c:v libx264 movie.m4v.
methods.limits: Re-encodes.

methods.steps: Run ffmpeg -i edit.mov -c copy -f mp4 repacked.m4v.
methods.limits: Only compatible tracks can be copied.

methods.steps: Run ffmpeg -i song.mp3 -c:a libvorbis -q:a 5 -f ogg song.oga.
methods.limits: Requires libvorbis; adds lossy encoding.

methods.steps: File > Export Audio; set the Format dropdown to Ogg Vorbis; the quality slider runs from 0 to 10.
methods.limits: Re-encodes the audio as lossy Vorbis.

methods.steps: Run ffmpeg -i recording.mp4 -c copy transport.ts.
methods.limits: Source codecs must be compatible with TS.

methods.steps: Run ffmpeg -i recording.mp4 -c:a aac -c:v libx264 -f mpegts recoded.ts.
methods.limits: Re-encodes for a selected codec requirement.

methods.steps: Run ffmpeg -i source.mpg legacy.wmv.
methods.limits: Inspect encoders selected by the installed build.

methods.steps: Run ffmpeg -i source.mpg -c:v wmv2 -c:a wmav2 specified.wmv.
methods.limits: Requires those encoders and adds lossy coding.

methods.steps: Run magick -font typeface.otf -pointsize 48 label:"Sample ABC 123" preview.png.
methods.limits: Draws selected text only.

methods.steps: Tools > Text; pick the typeface in the font selector, which lists installed fonts; enter a sample; File > Export As, choose PNG.
methods.limits: Needs an available installed font and the requested glyphs.

methods.steps: Use the Text tool and Text > Text and Font; select an installed family, enter a sample; File > Export PNG Image, choose Page, Drawing or Selection and set the image size in pixels.
methods.limits: Choose the output size in the export dialog.

methods.steps: Select slide; File > Save As; choose JPEG File Interchange Format; Save; Just This One.
methods.limits: Exports the chosen slide as a still image.

methods.steps: Open slide; File > Export; choose JPEG; Save Current Slide Only; set dimensions and Export.
methods.limits: A static export cannot preserve animation.

methods.steps: Open PPT; File > Export as > Export as PDF; then magick -density 150 slides.pdf slide.jpeg.
methods.limits: Requires Ghostscript for PDF input.

methods.steps: Run ffmpeg -i archive.rm -vn -c:a libmp3lame -b:a 192k realmedia-audio.mp3.
methods.limits: Requires RealMedia source decoding and LAME encoding.

methods.steps: Run ffmpeg -i media.swf -c:v libx264 -crf 27 -f flv -c:a aac direct.flv.
methods.limits: Reads only embedded media; no ActionScript or vector rendering.

methods.steps: Run ffmpeg -i media.swf -c copy -f flv copied.flv.
methods.limits: Extracted codecs must fit FLV; scripts/vectors are not rendered.

methods.steps: Run ffmpeg -i media.swf -c:v ffv1 -c:a pcm_s16le intermediate.mkv; inspect it; then ffmpeg -i intermediate.mkv -c:v libx264 -crf 27 -f flv -c:a aac reviewed.flv.
methods.limits: Two-stage media decode/encode; not a Flash runtime.

methods.steps: Run magick -background white -fill black -pointsize 20 -size 800x caption:@notes.txt notes.jpeg.
methods.limits: Needs an available font; security policy can disable the @file form; a trailing newline adds a blank line.

methods.steps: Tools > Text; load the TXT with the folder icon in the Text Editor window; arrange canvas; File > Export As, choose .jpeg.
methods.limits: Inspect encoding and line fit before export.

methods.steps: Type the text with the Text tool; set the font in Text > Text and Font; File > Export PNG Image; open the PNG in GIMP and File > Export As, choose JPEG.
methods.limits: Two-stage layout workflow, not direct TXT renaming.
